name: Vase
definition: open vessel made to hold cut or artificial flowers or to stand as an ornament; a tulip vase is a vase.
notes: Wayfair Type filter lists Table Vase, Floor Vase, Wall Vase; tulip not a separate type.

name: Ginger jar
definition: rounded lidded jar made for display.
notes: Ginger Jars is its own Type filter value at Wayfair.

name: Decorative urn
definition: large footed vessel made as an ornament, indoors or in the garden (a cremation urn is F4).
notes: Urns & Jars filter; garden shop also sells Stone Garden Urns.

name: Decorative bottle
definition: bottle made to be displayed, not to hold a drink.
notes: Decorative Bottles is a Type filter value in the vase department.

name: Decorative bowl
definition: bowl made to be looked at or to hold small decorative items (a bowl made to hold food is B5).
notes: Decorative bowls sold as a category (John Lewis, Westwing Dekoschalen).

name: Snow globe
definition: sealed liquid-filled globe holding a scene and loose particles that fall when shaken.
notes: Snow Globes sold as ornament sub-collection with lanterns.

name: Decorative wall panel
definition: carved, fretted or moulded panel made to hang on a wall as ornament.
notes: Carved wooden decorative wall panel sold as a product (Made in India).

name: Wall sticker or decal
definition: a self-adhesive vinyl or film motif, pattern or lettering applied to a wall, window or furniture to decorate it (DPH; provisional until a shop page shows wall stickers sold as a type).
notes: RoomMates wall decals sold under a wall decals product type.

name: Decorative replica weapon
definition: replica sword, gun or other weapon made for display that cannot injure, decorative wushu implements included (K-86, K-87).
notes: Sword sold as completely decorative with display plaque.

name: Deactivated ordnance (display piece)
definition: bomb, grenade, mine or artillery piece made inert and kept for display (K-85).
notes: Dealer sells deactivated grenades described as safe for display.

name: Wall mirror
definition: mirror with a hanging fitting, made to hang on a wall.
notes: IKEA lists Wall mirrors and Round/Decorative mirrors separately.

name: Floor mirror [leaner mirror]
definition: full-length mirror made to lean against a wall from the floor, with no hanging fitting.
notes: Dealer category Floor Mirrors and Full-Length Mirrors; some sold as wall or floor.

name: Standing mirror [cheval mirror]
definition: full-length mirror held in its own free-standing frame, often tilting.
notes: Cheval dressing mirrors sold as tilting free-standing floor pieces.

name: Table mirror [dresser mirror]
definition: plain mirror on a stand made to sit on a table or dresser (a grooming mirror is H1).
notes: Table mirrors appear as a dealer category; only a few listings.

name: Picture frame
definition: empty frame made to hold and display a picture or photograph.
notes: Photo frames and Picture Frames are shop categories.

name: Container candle [jar candle]
definition: candle poured into and burned in its own jar or vessel.
notes: Scented candles in glass; glass candles sold; page does not say jar.

name: Tealight
definition: small candle in a shallow metal or plastic cup.
notes: Tealight is a sold candle form.

name: Votive candle
definition: short candle made to burn standing in a holder that contains the melted wax.
notes: Votive candles listed as a type.

name: Taper candle
definition: long, slender candle made for a candlestick.
notes: Taper candles sold, 12 inch.

name: Pillar candle
definition: thick free-standing candle that burns without a container.
notes: Pillar candles sold in several sizes.

name: Candle holder
definition: open holder made to hold a lit candle; holder form is an attribute (provisional: a holder form becomes a kind if fetched shops sell and compare it as its own category).
notes: Candlesticks, tealight holders and candle holders sold under one Candle Holders category.

name: Candle snuffer
definition: tool with a small bell on a handle made to put out a candle flame.
notes: Category Candle Wick Trimmers, Snuffers & Tools.

name: Reed diffuser
definition: vessel of scented oil with reeds that draw it up and release it into a room.
notes: Reed Diffusers & Fragrance Oils is a category.

name: Electric diffuser [plug-in diffuser]
definition: powered device made to release fragrance into a room (K-183, B4-O3).
notes: Wall plug-in diffuser sold, electrical, takes refills.

name: Wax melt
definition: scented wax piece made to be melted in a warmer, not burned.
notes: Wax Melts is a category.

name: Wax warmer
definition: burner or electric warmer made to melt wax melts or oil (K-183).
notes: Wax Warmers is a category.

name: Room spray
definition: aerosol or pump spray made to scent a room.
notes: Room Sprays & Linen Sprays listed in home fragrance menu.

name: Potpourri
definition: mixture of dried scented plant material displayed to scent a room.
notes: Potpourri sold as home fragrance product.

name: Diffuser oil
definition: essential or fragrance oil sold for a diffuser or burner (K-183; an oil sold to treat a condition is H2).
notes: Fragrance oils sold with reed diffusers; Centrepoint has FRAGRANCE OILS banner.

name: Stick incense
definition: incense formed on or as a stick, burned to scent a room.
notes: Stick incense (short, regular, long, bamboo) sold by form.

name: Cone incense
definition: incense pressed into a cone.
notes: Cone incense sold as a form.

name: Coil incense
definition: incense formed as a long-burning coil.
notes: Coil incense sold as a form.

name: Incense burner
definition: holder or burner made to burn home-fragrance incense (a rite burner is F4).
notes: Incense burners, plates and holders sold as accessories.

name: Smudge bundle
definition: bound bundle of dried herbs burned to scent or cleanse a room, not made for a named rite (K-115).
notes: Smudge sticks and resins sold, plus smudge bowls.

name: Tree ornament [bauble]
definition: ornament made to hang on a tree or festive display, whatever its theme.
notes: Ornaments sold by theme; also Christmas Baubles category (M&S).

name: Tree topper
definition: ornament made to sit on the top of a tree.
notes: Tree Toppers category.

name: Garland
definition: long strand of foliage, tinsel, beads or other decoration made to drape or hang.
notes: Christmas Garlands category; decorative garland sold as party item.

name: Bunting
definition: string of pennant-shaped flags hung as a festive decoration.
notes: Bunting is a Type filter in the flag department and a product at Kmart.

name: Paper streamer
definition: long strip or roll of paper hung or thrown as a party decoration.
notes: Streamer rolls listed among party decorations.

name: Artificial Christmas tree
definition: manufactured tree made to be decorated for Christmas (a real tree is C3, K-72).
notes: Artificial Christmas Trees category with pre-lit models.

name: Festival doll display
definition: set of dolls made to be displayed on tiers for a festival, not made for worship.
notes: Hina doll sets (tiered, compact case, flat) sold by dolls shops.

name: Entrance decoration [kadomatsu]
definition: seasonal arrangement made to stand at an entrance for a festival (B4-O2, K-116).
notes: New Year Kadomatsu sold made to order by a Taiwan studio.

name: Christmas cracker
definition: paper tube pulled apart by two people with a snap, holding small gifts.
notes: Christmas Crackers is a category; each holds hat, motto, snap, gift.

name: Party popper
definition: hand-held device that bursts with a bang and throws out streamers.
notes: Confetti & Party Poppers category.

name: Sparkler
definition: hand-held wire coated with a slow-burning pyrotechnic that throws sparks (B-19).
notes: Sparklers is a category beside fireworks.

name: Firework
definition: pyrotechnic device made to give a display of light, colour or noise (B-19).
notes: Consumer fireworks sold under maker ranges (F2/F3 categories on site).

name: Fog or haze machine
definition: machine that makes fog or haze for a party or display effect (K-145).
notes: Smoke machines and hazers sold by many makers.

name: Artificial flower
definition: manufactured imitation of a flower, single stem or arranged.
notes: Artificial flowers category.

name: Artificial plant
definition: manufactured imitation of a plant other than a flower, foliage and trees included (K-74).
notes: Artificial plants category.

name: Preserved plant [stabilised plant]
definition: real plant or moss treated so that it keeps its look without growing or care (K-74).
notes: Framed preserved reindeer moss wall art sold.

name: Dried flowers
definition: real flowers dried for display.
notes: Trockenblumen (dried flowers) category.

name: Garden statue
definition: statue made to stand outdoors as a garden ornament.
notes: Stone Garden Statues category.

name: Garden gnome
definition: figure of a gnome made as a garden ornament.
notes: Gartenzwerge (gnomes) listed with garden figures.

name: Gazing ball [yard globe]
definition: reflective sphere on a stand made as a garden ornament.
notes: Gazing globe sold as garden ornament.

name: Weathervane
definition: rotating ornament on a rod that turns to show the wind direction.
notes: Cat & Ball weathervane sold for garden buildings.

name: Wind chime
definition: set of hanging tubes, rods or bells that sound when moved by the wind.
notes: Wind chimes sold as a category beside spinners.

name: Garden fountain or water feature
definition: ornamental fountain or flowing-water feature for a garden (B4-O1; its pump is C2, K-175).
notes: Garden Fountains and Water Features categories.

name: National flag
definition: flag of a country, made to fly or hang.
notes: World Flags and American Flags sold.

name: State or territory flag
definition: flag of a state, province or territory.
notes: State Flags with individual state pages.

name: Garden flag
definition: small flag made to hang from a garden stake or stand.
notes: Garden Flag is a Type filter value.

name: Pennant
definition: tapering flag, usually triangular.
notes: Pennant is a Type filter value.

name: Decorative windsock or wind streamer
definition: windsock or streamer made as a garden, festive or decorative ornament (DPH rename; a windsock made to show wind direction or strength is C6).
notes: Wind Sock Type sold in house-flag department; decorative use not stated.

name: Hanging sign
definition: sign made to hang from a bracket, chain or cord.
notes: Hanging pub signs and framed hanging signs sold with brackets.

name: Illuminated sign
definition: neon or LED sign made to show a lit word or motif, a decorative light that spells a message included.
notes: Custom LED neon sign sold; dealer sells vintage neon wall signs.

name: String light [fairy light]
definition: string of small lights made mainly as decoration (K-181).
notes: String and Fairy Lights category.

name: Flameless candle
definition: battery or LED light made in the shape of a candle.
notes: Flameless Candles is a category.

name: Lava lamp
definition: lamp in which heated wax rises and falls in a liquid, made mainly as decoration.
notes: Lava lamps sold by Mathmos (Astro, Telstar).

name: Decorative lantern
definition: lantern made to stand or hang as decoration, lit or unlit, stone garden lanterns included (K-116, K-180).
notes: Decorative lanterns category at hardware and household stores.

name: Flagpole
definition: pole made to fly a flag (K-192).
notes: Flagpoles sold in-ground, indoor, commercial, residential.
